summary: The staff and admin panels now open on dashboards, keep their navigation on missing or restricted pages, and make long lists and destructive actions easier and safer to use.
detailed_changes: A staff dashboard at /staff shows draft, review, scheduled and recently published counts that link to filtered post lists, items needing attention, recent activity, reader insights and quick actions for a new post, page or newsletter (#351).
An admin dashboard at /admin shows moderation queue sizes, the latest release, settings shortcuts and recent audit events (#352).
Dashboard is the first item in each panel's sidebar, and the Staff/Admin switch, breadcrumbs and Ctrl K search now lead to the dashboards (#351, #352).

Unknown /staff and /admin addresses show a page-not-found message inside the panel, and pages a role cannot open explain which role is needed, both with a link back to the dashboard; public error pages are unchanged (#354).

Every panel tab title now reads 'Page - Staff - APES Newsroom' or 'Page - Admin - APES Newsroom', and sidebar labels match page headings, for example Membership plans, Media library and Sending domains (#355).
Pages and Newsletters are paginated with search kept in the address bar; Posts, Pages and Newsletters move row actions into a menu, and delete, unpublish and archive ask for confirmation (#356).
Stripe price ids, test-mode revenue and webhook signing details are shown only to admins, inside an Advanced section, and are no longer sent to staff (#357).
Keyboard focus returns to the row menu when a confirmation is cancelled, and automated accessibility, layout and screenshot checks now cover the dashboards and the in-panel error pages (#359, #360).
affected_areas: User groups affected: staff, admins and super admins

Internal impact: new Staff and Admin DashboardControllers, PanelNotFoundController panel fallback routes, PanelErrorPage and Errors/Panel for in-panel 403/404, WorkspaceLayout owns the document title, paginated Pages and Newsletters indexes, admin-only Stripe and MRR props, ModerationCounts service, MetricsDashboard split by section, Playwright panels spec
